concepts.name: recordedCase
concepts.description: An encapsulation of a past experience.

concepts.name: newProblem
concepts.description: A problem requiring a solution based on prior cases.

concepts.name: caseMemory
concepts.description: A collection of previously recorded cases.

concepts.name: distanceSet
concepts.description: Distances between the new problem and stored cases.

concepts.name: configuration
concepts.description: State of a problem before and after case retrieval.

concepts.name: caseSolution
concepts.description: The solution associated with a recorded case.

concepts.name: candidateSolution
concepts.description: A transferred case solution before it has been adapted or accepted.

concepts.name: adaptedSolution
concepts.description: A case solution modified or confirmed for the current problem.

concepts.name: adaptationEvaluation
concepts.description: Assessment of whether an adapted solution fits the new problem.

assertions.name: goodCaseRetrieval
assertions.description: The solution considered for the new problem comes from a retrieved similar recorded case.

assertions.name: transferredCaseSolution
assertions.description: A retrieved case solution has been transferred as a candidate for the new problem.

assertions.name: adaptedCaseSolution
assertions.description: The transferred case solution has been modified or confirmed for the current problem.

assertions.name: acceptableAdaptation
assertions.description: The adapted case solution is suitable enough to accept for the new problem.
